liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Stop Draggin' My Heart Around**: rare: 3 archived performances [8]

## The recordings

- **mmj2011-08-20.mk4v.m221b.flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 134 min [1]
- **mmj2011-08-20.dpasax.flacf16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 134 min [7]
- **mmj2011-08-20.mk4v.m221b.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 134 min [2]
- **mmj2011-08-20.mk4v.m221b-mk21.m222.flac24**: source not stated; 21 songs; 134 min [3]

## Around the show

- Neko Case performed Stop Draggin' My Heart Around with the band [1]
- PA issues reduced sound pressure from 4:10 to 4:24 during the song [7]
- The show followed a performance at Time Warner Cable Amphitheatre in Charlotte [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2011-08-20.mk4v.m221b.flac24**: taped by Taylor Caine; transferred by taylorc; source: [24bit] Schoeps mk4v> AMC3> M221B> EAA PSP-2> SD 744t (@24bit/96kHz) [1]
- **mmj2011-08-20.dpasax.flacf16**: taped by Brian Hadella; transferred by Brian Hadella; source: DPA 4022 (5' ROC at FOH, 8' up, DIN) > Sonosax SX-M2 > Sound Devices USBPre 2 > Edirol R44 (24/48) [7]
- **mmj2011-08-20.mk4v.m221b.flac16**: taped by Taylor Caine; transferred by taylorc; source: [16bit] Schoeps mk4v> AMC3> M221B> EAA PSP-2> SD 744t (@24bit/96kHz) [2]
- **mmj2011-08-20.mk4v.m221b-mk21.m222.flac24**: taped by Taylor Caine; transferred by taylorc; source: [24bit] Schoeps mk4v> AMC3> M221B> EAA PSP-2 + Schoeps mk21> KC5> M222> NT222> Aeta PSP-3> SD 744t (@24bit/96kHz) [3]
